redeem: Launch Sniper Arena on Roblox and wait in the lobby.
Click the gear (settings) icon in the top-left corner, next to the chat button.
Choose Redeem Code from the settings menu.
Paste a code into the box, keeping lowercase letters lowercase, and press the green Redeem button.
notes:
Sniper Arena is a free-for-all shooter from 9D GAME CLUB where every player fights with a sniper rifle. Matches have quick respawns, and you can also queue for Ranked matches that pay out better rewards. You earn credits in each match to unlock new snipers and open crates, and every skin is cosmetic only, so no gun shoots better than another.

Codes here hand out cases and knife skins instead of currency. The Secret Case from 20000ccu is the one to open first, because it has a shot at rarer skins that you can sell on the player market for cash. New codes usually appear when the game hits milestones such as player counts, visits or like goals, and they go up in the Discord codes channel.

faq.q: Why does the Sniper Arena code freecase say invalid?
faq.a: Codes in this game are case-sensitive, and some are all lowercase. Type freecase and 20000ccu in lowercase, and FREELIKE5 in capitals.

faq.q: Where is the redeem button in Sniper Arena?
faq.a: It is inside the settings menu. Click the gear icon in the top-left of the lobby, then pick Redeem Code.

faq.q: Can I sell skins I get from Sniper Arena codes?
faq.a: Yes, most skins can be listed on the in-game player market for cash, which you can then use on premium skins. Some special case rewards are marked untradeable, so check the item first.

tips: Hold right click to aim before every shot, then left click to fire. On controller, aim with L2 and shoot with R2.
Use Ctrl or C to crouch and slide between spots. A sliding target is harder to hit than one standing still.
Play with friends when you can. The game gives 20% more in-match Credits when you play together, which unlocks new snipers sooner.
Before selling a skin on the market, look at what similar skins are listed for. Prices are set by players, so a quick sale can mean less cash.
useRewards: All three working codes give items instead of Credits. Open both cases soon to see what you get, and sell any skin you do not want on the player market for cash. The random Mystic Knife from FREELIKE5 is a cosmetic for your loadout. Like codes come in numbered order and expire, as FREELIKE1 to FREELIKE4 did, so grab each new one quickly.
